edits.before: 作者认为，把这次交还和一般的口头表态分开看，可以看出三件事同时在进行。其一，次序是事先写定的：22日议定，23日执行。其二，礼节是不对称的：将军起身致辞和退场时鞠躬，国会以脱帽回礼，站着的鞠躬、坐着的回礼，高低位差被保留了下来。其三，交出的是实物——委任状，外加讲稿副本。仪式、姿态、凭证三者叠加，才构成这一次有记录的权力交还。
edits.after: 作者认为，把这次交还和一般的口头表态分开看，可以看出三件事同时在进行。其一，次序是事先写定的：22日议定，23日执行。其二，礼节是不对称的：按规定，将军起身致辞和退场时要鞠躬，国会以脱帽回礼——站着的鞠躬、坐着的回礼，高低位差被写进了规则。其三，交出的是实物——委任状，外加讲稿副本。仪式、按规定的姿态、凭证三者叠加，才构成这一次权力交还；关于姿态，日志记下的是规定，而不是执行情况。

edits.before: As the author reads it, setting this handover beside an ordinary spoken one shows three things happening at once. First, the sequence was fixed in advance: agreed on the twenty-second, carried out on the twenty-third. Second, the etiquette was asymmetric: the General was to bow when he rose to speak and when he withdrew, and Congress to answer by uncovering: the standing man bowed, the seated body answered. The vertical distance between them was kept visible. Third, what changed hands was physical: the commission, plus a copy of the address. Ceremony, posture, and token together make up this documented transfer of power.
edits.after: As the author reads it, setting this handover beside an ordinary spoken one shows three things happening at once. First, the sequence was fixed in advance: agreed on the twenty-second, carried out on the twenty-third. Second, the etiquette was asymmetric: the General was to bow when he rose to speak and when he withdrew, and Congress to answer by uncovering: the standing man was to bow, the seated body to answer. The rule wrote the vertical distance between them into the procedure. Third, what changed hands was physical: the commission, plus a copy of the address. Ceremony, prescribed posture, and token together make up this transfer of power; as for posture, what the journal records is the rule, not how it was carried out.

edits.before: Three technical reservations follow. First, Congress's answer appears in the journal, and this piece quotes only the stretches of it that the OCR renders cleanly. Second, the material comes from OCR of a facsimile and contains misreadings, so the English quotations here take only clean stretches, with doubtful spellings left outside the quotation marks. Third, the printed journal marks changes to the draft protocol with brackets, and according to the editors' note the bracketed words are in Boudinot's writing; the OCR text this piece relies on cannot show whether the draft carries any other deletions or revisions, so this piece reports only what is in the brackets.
